items.title: 波士頓Fed總裁柯林斯：今年底前仍可能再升息
items.title_en: Boston Fed President Collins: Another Rate Hike May Still Be Possible Before Year-End
paras: 《路透社》報導，波士頓聯準銀行(Fed)總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)週二(13日)表示，為了降低居高不下的通膨，美國央行今年底前可能還需要再次升息。
柯林斯表示，她支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上個月的升息決策，目前仍認為，「為確保通膨能及時且持續地回到委員會設定的2%目標，今年底前進一步小幅升息將是適當的做法。」
她在波士頓聯準銀行一場銀行業會議的演講中指出，「我是否認為有必要進一步採取貨幣政策行動，以及採取行動的適當時機，將在很大程度上取決於接下來公布的各項數據如何影響我的經濟展望，以及相關風險的平衡。」
柯林斯表示，目前美國經濟與就業市場表現良好，聯準會因此能夠將工作重心放在降低通膨、使其回到目標水準。過去五年多來，聯準會一直未能達成這項通膨目標。
聯準會上個月將政策利率調升0.25個百分點，使利率區間升至3.75%至4.00%。
聯準會官員在當次會議公布的利率預測顯示，2026年底前還會再升息一次。不過，近幾週已有多名官員強烈暗示，下一次升息可能會在12月進行，而非10月27日至28日的會議。
柯林斯對經濟前景整體持樂觀看法，但也承認其中存在風險。
她表示，最有可能出現的情境「仍是國內生產毛額(GDP)維持健康成長，就業市場則接近充分就業」。在這種情境下，隨著效率持續提升，有助於維持供給與需求之間的平衡，並降低通膨壓力，通膨率將逐步回到 2%。
然而，她指出，科技業為建置人工智慧(AI)基礎設施而增加的投資，以及關稅與中東戰爭推升能源成本所帶來的持續影響，都可能使降低通膨的工作更加複雜。
柯林斯補充，「考量到近期航空燃油、柴油及家庭取暖用油等精煉能源產品價格大幅上漲，我預期未來幾個月，整體通膨率與核心通膨率都將再次高於聯準會設定的2%目標。」
paras_en: Reuters reported that Boston Federal Reserve Bank President Susan Collins said on Tuesday (the 13th) that, to bring down persistently high inflation, the U.S. central bank may need to raise rates again before the end of the year.

Collins said she supports the Federal Open Market Committee’s rate‑hike decision last month and still believes that, to ensure inflation returns promptly and sustainably to the Committee’s 2% target, a modest further increase before year‑end would be appropriate.

Speaking at a banking‑industry conference hosted by the Boston Fed, she noted that whether further monetary‑policy action is needed and the timing of such action will largely depend on how upcoming data shape her economic outlook and the balance of associated risks.

Collins said the U.S. economy and labor market are performing well, allowing the Fed to keep its focus on lowering inflation back to target levels. Over the past five‑plus years, the Fed has repeatedly missed that inflation goal.
The Fed raised its policy rate by a quarter‑percentage point last month, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%.

Rate‑forecast figures released at that meeting indicated another hike could occur before the end of 2026, but in recent weeks several officials have strongly hinted that the next increase may come in December rather than at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting.
Collins remains broadly optimistic about the economic outlook, though she acknowledges there are risks.

She said the most likely scenario is that GDP continues to grow healthily while the labor market stays near full employment; in that environment, rising efficiency should help keep supply and demand balanced and ease inflation pressure, gradually bringing the inflation rate back to 2%.

However, she warned that increased investment in AI infrastructure by the tech sector, as well as higher energy costs driven by tariffs and the Middle‑East war, could make the task of lowering inflation more complicated.

Collins added that, given the recent sharp rise in prices for refined energy products such as jet fuel, diesel and home heating oil, she expects overall inflation and core inflation to remain above the Fed’s 2% target for the next several months.

items.title: 長鑫新技術打崩美光、SanDisk？瑞穗列七大理由勸別急著賣
items.title_en: New Technology from ChangXin Challenges Micron, SanDisk? Mizuho Lists Seven Reasons Not to Rush to Sell
paras: 中國長鑫儲存(688825-CN) 宣稱，將於年底前推出採用4F²記憶單元設計的DDR5 RDIMM，記憶單元面積縮小約三分之一。不過，瑞穗科技、媒體與電信（TMT）產業專家Jordan Klein表示，這項消息並未改變美光科技(MU-US) 、SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 或三星電子(005930KS) 投資人的短期投資判斷。
Klein在致客戶報告中寫道：「如果我持有美光、SanDisk、SK海力士或三星，不會因為長鑫高層昨天談到新一代先進DDR5設計藍圖，就拋售持股或陷入恐慌。在我看來，這並未改變短期局勢。這件事值得密切追蹤，但也僅止於此。」
長鑫這項技術藍圖的核心，是結合4F²記憶單元架構與垂直環繞閘極電晶體的DDR5 RDIMM，目標於2026年底前推出產品。
根據瑞穗對長鑫說法的整理，這款記憶單元的面積，將比目前DDR5採用的6F²設計縮小約三分之一。
Klein提出七項理由，說明這項消息為何遠不足以構成競爭威脅。其中最關鍵的是時程比較基準不同：據報導，三星同類4F² DRAM技術的量產目標為2028年，長鑫則宣稱將於2026年底前推出產品。
Klein認為，這兩項里程碑無法直接比較。他寫道：「年底推出產品，不能直接拿來與外界報導的三星2028年量產目標相比。產品亮相，並不代表製造成熟度、良率或成本競爭力已獲得驗證。」
對於令部分記憶體投資人不安的供給過剩疑慮，Klein同樣抱持懷疑態度。他指出：「長鑫尚未證明其4F²產品已成功量產，也未提供經驗證的良率與效能，因此現在就認定供給即將過剩，還言之過早。」
長鑫尚未公布這款4F²伺服器RDIMM的完整規格、經驗證的良率、客戶認證結果，或商業規模的出貨承諾。
Klein也反駁記憶單元面積縮小就必然降低晶片成本的假設，指出製程複雜度、良率與整合等因素，都會影響最終成本，而長鑫尚未證明在這些方面已具備與競爭對手相當的實力。
他進一步強調，這款產品屬於傳統伺服器DRAM，並非高頻寬記憶體（HBM）。HBM採用堆疊式記憶體架構，是以GPU與ASIC為核心的AI加速器機櫃的重要組成部分。
這項差異意味著，長鑫短期內對AI運算基礎建設擴張的影響有限，而這波建設熱潮正是推升主要記憶體供應商估值溢價的動力。
值得注意的是，布局4F²技術並非中國獨有。瑞穗指出，三星與SK海力士也在推進類似的DDR5 4F²設計，意味著這項技術是整個產業的轉型方向，而非中國獨有的突破。
據稱，Digitimes一篇被Klein形容為「較為平衡」的報導，也對長鑫宣稱的技術進展潑了冷水，進一步支持他的審慎看法。
不過，Klein並未全盤否定長鑫的長期競爭潛力。他寫道：「不能輕忽長鑫，也不能輕忽其NAND同業長江存儲（YMTC），我也沒有這麼做。」他並補充，長鑫正積極投資，以向中國國內客戶供應傳統DRAM及更先進的記憶體。
paras_en: China ChangXin Storage (688825-CN) announced it will launch a DDR5 RDIMM using a 4F² memory cell design by the end of the year, shrinking the cell area by about one‑third. However, Mizuho Technology, Media and Telecom (TMT) expert Jordan Klein said the news does not change short‑term investment judgments for investors in Micron (MU-US), SanDisk (SNDKV-US), SK Hynix (000660KS) or Samsung Electronics (005930KS).

Klein wrote in a client report: “If I hold Micron, SanDisk, SK Hynix or Samsung, I would not dump my shares or panic just because ChangXin’s senior management talked about a new advanced DDR5 design blueprint yesterday. In my view, this does not alter the short‑term landscape. The matter is worth close monitoring, but that’s all.”

The core of ChangXin’s technology blueprint is a DDR5 RDIMM that combines a 4F² memory cell architecture with vertically wrapped gate transistors, with a target to bring the product to market by the end of 2026.
According to Mizuho’s summary of ChangXin’s statements, the memory cell area will be about one‑third smaller than the current 6F² design used in DDR5 today.

Klein listed seven reasons why the news falls far short of constituting a competitive threat. The most critical is that the timing benchmarks differ: reports say Samsung’s comparable 4F² DRAM aims for mass production in 2028, while ChangXin claims to launch a product by the end of 2026.

Klein argues the two milestones cannot be compared directly. He wrote: “A product debut at year‑end cannot be directly measured against Samsung’s reported 2028 mass‑production target. A product appearance does not prove manufacturing maturity, yield, or cost competitiveness.”

Regarding some memory investors’ worries about oversupply, Klein is equally skeptical. He noted: “ChangXin has not proven that its 4F² product is in volume production, nor provided verified yield and performance data, so it is premature to claim an imminent supply glut.”
ChangXin has not released the full specifications, verified yields, customer qualification results, or commercial‑scale shipment commitments for this 4F² server RDIMM.

Klein also refutes the assumption that a smaller cell area automatically reduces chip cost, pointing out that process complexity, yield, and integration factors all affect final cost, and ChangXin has not demonstrated parity with rivals in these areas yet.

He further emphasizes that the product is a conventional server DRAM, not high‑bandwidth memory (HBM). HBM uses a stacked memory architecture and is a key component of AI accelerator racks built around GPUs and ASICs.

This distinction means ChangXin’s short‑term impact on AI compute infrastructure expansion is limited, and the current AI build‑out wave is what is driving valuation premiums for the major memory suppliers.

It is noteworthy that the 4F² roadmap is not unique to China. Mizuho points out that Samsung and SK Hynix are also pursuing similar DDR5 4F² designs, indicating the technology is an industry‑wide transition rather than a China‑only breakthrough.
According to a Digitimes article that Klein described as “relatively balanced,” the report also poured cold water on ChangXin’s claimed progress, further supporting his cautious view.

However, Klein does not dismiss ChangXin’s long‑term competitive potential entirely. He wrote: “We cannot overlook ChangXin, nor can we overlook its NAND peer Yangtze Memory (YMTC); I do not do either.” He added that ChangXin is actively investing to supply traditional DRAM and more advanced memory to domestic Chinese customers.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元自18個月高點回落 油價下跌、通膨數據受矚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slides from 18-Month High as Oil Prices Fall, Inflation Data in Focus
paras: 美元周二(13日)自18個月高點滑落，隨著油價下跌，加上市場重新評估今年支撐美國資產需求、由人工智慧(AI)題材帶動的漲勢。投資人同時等待更多有關聯準會(Fed)利率政策走向的線索。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.37%，報102.18。該指數週一曾升至102.61，創2025年4月以來最高。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta表示，「隨著市場對AI相關股票估值的合理性及漲勢能否持續產生更多疑慮，美元正走弱。這可能抑制流入美國金融市場的資金。」
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，他仍預期今年會再升息一次，但認為2027年沒有必要進一步升息。此番言論公布後，美元跌幅進一步擴大。
市場預期，美國總統川普將避免中東局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能損害他在下個月期中選舉前的政治支持度。
川普上週表示，美國不會在選舉前攻擊伊朗，他也在週日提及俄羅斯與烏克蘭之間的能源停火安排。
週二油價下跌0.75%，至每桶105.87 美元，交易人士正評估俄羅斯是否可能額外增加柴油供應。俄羅斯表示，其柴油出口量可恢復至高於川普在與莫斯科達成的協議中所提及水準。
分析師指出，除了能源因素之外，市場對AI帶動投資的前景日益存疑，也正在挑戰近期美元漲勢。
投資人正等待週三公布的美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)，這項數據將進一步提供聯準會未來是否收緊貨幣政策的線索。
在兩名聯準會官員主張應蒐集更多證據，再決定是否有必要進一步緊縮政策後，投資人已放棄對本月稍晚升息的押注。
芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員預期聯準會在10月27至28日會議上維持利率不變的機率約為80%，高於一個月前的51%。另一方面，市場目前預期截至2027年底，聯準會累計緊縮幅度約為75個基點。
渣打銀行全球G10外匯研究主管暨北美宏觀策略主管Steven Englander表示，「我們認為通膨數據可能會略低於預期。油價仍帶來一些數據公布前的風險，但推升核心通膨的部分因素正在消退。關稅已經是去年的話題了。」
近期油價上漲曾支撐美元，並使歐元、日元等貨幣承壓，因歐元區與日本的經濟對進口石油的依賴程度遠高於美國。
歐元反彈 儘管天然氣價格升高
儘管天然氣價格再度大漲，而天然氣是推升歐元區通膨的重要因素之一，加上法國財政前景仍令人擔憂，歐元仍從約17個月低點反彈。
歐元兌美元上漲0.40%，至1歐元兌1.1198 美元。週一歐元曾跌至1.11525美元，為2025年5月以來最低。
Englander表示，「歐洲各國公債殖利率利差略有收斂。就市場對法國財政脆弱性的看法而言，我們還沒有到達最高警戒狀態，相關擔憂已經有所緩和。」
歐洲天然氣價格升至2022年12月以來最高水準，最新報價為每百萬瓦時86.74歐元。
日本銀行(BoJ)公布數據顯示，日本9月批發物價年增率為6.8%，低於市場預估中位數的7.6%。儘管如此，數據仍足以支撐市場對日本利率可能進一步上升的擔憂。日元兌美元升值0.18%，至158.33日元兌1美元。
投資人仍認為，日銀進一步收緊貨幣政策的可能性，以及官方可能出手干預過度的匯率波動，將為日元提供支撐。
澳幣兌美元報0.69830美元。此前，澳洲央行(RBA)公布9月會議紀錄，顯示委員會一致同意今年第四度升息。

paras_en: The dollar slipped from its 18‑month peak on Tuesday (the 13th) as oil prices fell and the market reassessed this year’s demand for U.S. assets, which had been buoyed by AI‑related themes. Investors are also waiting for more clues on the Federal Reserve’s rate‑policy direction.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.37% to 102.18. The index had risen to 102.61 on Monday, its highest level since April 2025.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said, “As the market grows more skeptical about the valuation and sustainability of AI‑related stocks, the dollar is weakening. This could curb capital flows into U.S. financial markets.”

New York Fed Bank President John Williams said he still expects one more rate hike this year but sees no need for further tightening in 2027. The dollar’s decline widened after his comments were released.
The market expects President Trump to avoid a further escalation in the Middle East, as a larger conflict could damage his political support ahead of next month’s mid‑term elections.
Trump said last week that the United States would not attack Iran before the election, and on Sunday he also referenced the energy cease‑fire arrangement between Russia and Ukraine.

Oil prices fell 0.75% on Tuesday to $105.87 a barrel as traders evaluated whether Russia might increase diesel supplies. Russia said its diesel exports could rise above the levels mentioned in Trump’s agreement with Moscow.
Analysts note that beyond energy factors, doubts are growing about the investment outlook driven by AI, which is also challenging the recent dollar rally.
Investors are awaiting the U.S. September Consumer Price Index (CPI) release on Wednesday, which will provide further clues on whether the Fed will tighten monetary policy further.
After two Fed officials argued that more evidence should be gathered before deciding on additional tightening, investors have abandoned bets on a rate hike later this month.

CME Group’s FedWatch tool shows traders now assign about an 80% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged at its Oct. 27‑28 meeting, up from 51% a month ago. The market also expects the Fed’s cumulative tightening by the end of 2027 to be about 75 basis points.

Standard Chartered’s global G10 FX research head and North America macro‑strategy lead Steven Englander said, “We think inflation data may come in slightly below expectations. Oil prices still pose some pre‑data‑release risk, but the factors pushing core inflation are receding. Tariffs were already a topic of last year.”
Recent oil price gains had supported the dollar and put pressure on the euro, yen and other currencies, as the euro‑zone and Japan rely far more on imported oil than the United States does.
Euro rebounds despite higher gas prices

Even though natural‑gas prices have surged again—and gas is a key driver of euro‑zone inflation—combined with lingering concerns over France’s fiscal outlook, the euro has bounced from a roughly 17‑month low.
The euro rose 0.40% against the dollar to $1.1198. On Monday it had slipped to $1.11525, the lowest since May 2025.

Englander added, “Euro‑area sovereign‑yield spreads have narrowed slightly. Regarding market views on France’s fiscal fragility, we haven’t hit the highest alert level yet, and related worries have eased.”
European natural‑gas prices climbed to their highest level since December 2022, now at €86.74 per megawatt‑hour.

Bank of Japan data showed Japan’s September wholesale‑price year‑over‑year growth at 6.8%, below the median market forecast of 7.6%. Nonetheless, the figure is enough to sustain concerns that Japanese rates could rise further. The yen appreciated 0.18% to ¥158.33 per dollar.
Investors still believe that the possibility of further BOJ tightening and potential official intervention to curb excessive exchange‑rate moves will support the yen.
The Australian dollar was at $0.69830. Earlier, the Reserve Bank of Australia released September meeting minutes showing the committee unanimously agreed to a fourth rate hike this year.

items.title: 以為搭上AI列車卻進了賭場？博通CEO點破盲點 呼應巴菲特忠告
items.title_en: Thought They Were Boarding the AI Train but Ended Up in a Casino? Broadcom CEO Highlights the Blind Spot, Echoing Buffett's Advice
paras: 巴菲特一向主張，投資人應投資自己了解的企業，而博通(AVGO-US) 執行長陳福陽認為，太多人已跨越這條界線，盲目投入市場。
巴菲特在1996年致波克夏股東的信中寫道：「投資人需要的，是正確評估特定企業的能力。你只需要能夠評估自己能力圈內的企業。這個圈子的大小並不重要，但知道它的界線至關重要。」
博通執行長陳福陽認為，太多人已跨越這條界線，盲目投入市場。
據《彭博》報導，他在新加坡表示：「許多投資人根本不知道自己在投資什麼。」他補充，這些投資人抱持「極高的期待，最後才發現自己幾乎就像置身賭場」。
巴菲特本人也並非總能精準掌握科技投資。他談到Google(GOOGL-US)時，曾感嘆這家公司不在自己的「能力圈」內，因此很晚才買進。
然而，隨著更難理解的AI技術崛起，遵循巴菲特這項原則變得更加困難。不是每個人都像班艾佛列克那樣了解AI，但也沒有人想被拋在後頭。
陳福陽與巴菲特的出發點不難理解，這也解釋了為何巴菲特提倡投資簡單的指數型基金，認為這對大多數人而言是更好的選擇。
值得說明的是，作為博通的掌舵者，陳福陽對產業前景依然看好。但他同時對長期的資本消耗感到擔憂，並直言 AI 的獲利能力最終將取決於它能否為企業帶來實質效益；然而，他認為目前許多企業的投入可能只是在「浪費錢」。
陳福陽的提醒若用另一種方式解讀，那就是：眼前這些令人驚嘆的 AI 技術固然強大，但它的「厲害」就好比法拉利跑車——之所以表現卓絕，是因為造價高昂。但在許多實際商業場景中，付出一比一的高額代價，卻未必能換來相應的實用價值。
儘管如此，一般散戶看到Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、AlphabetGOOGL-US)等企業大舉押注，很難不認為，自己只是跟隨比自己更了解這項技術及其影響的企業投資，而這些企業的信心之強，足以讓它們投入巨資。
不過，陳福陽這番話的精髓或許在於更細微的層面：投資人應該規避的是 AI 交易中「賭博式」的投機行為，而非完全拒絕 AI 概念本身。
畢竟在標普 500 指數中，有龐大權重都由 AI 概念股支撐，即便謹記「奧馬哈先知」至今依然適用的忠告，在當前的市場環境下，恐怕也早已無法完全置身事外。
paras_en: Buffett has long advocated that investors should stick to businesses they understand, and Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan believes many have crossed that line, blindly jumping into the market.

In his 1996 letter to Berkshire shareholders, Buffett wrote: "What investors need is the ability to correctly assess a particular company. You only need to be able to assess companies within your circle of competence. The size of the circle doesn’t matter, but knowing its boundaries is crucial."
Broadcom CEO Hock Tan says too many people have crossed that line and are investing blindly.

According to Bloomberg, he said in Singapore: "Many investors don’t even know what they are investing in." He added that these investors have "extremely high expectations, only to find themselves feeling like they are in a casino."
Buffett himself hasn’t always been spot‑on with tech investments. When discussing Google (GOOGL-US), he admitted the company was outside his circle of competence, so he bought it very late.
However, as ever‑more opaque AI technologies emerge, following Buffett’s rule becomes harder. Not everyone understands AI like Ben Efron, but no one wants to be left behind.
Tan’s and Buffett’s starting points are easy to grasp, which also explains why Buffett champions simple index funds as a better choice for most people.

It’s worth noting that, as Broadcom’s captain, Tan remains optimistic about industry prospects. Yet he worries about long‑term capital consumption and bluntly says AI’s profitability will ultimately depend on whether it delivers real benefits to companies; he believes many firms are currently just "wasting money" on AI.

If we read Tan’s warning another way, the dazzling AI technologies today are powerful, but their "wow factor" is like a Ferrari – exceptional performance comes at a very high cost. In many real‑world business scenarios, paying a one‑to‑one premium may not yield commensurate practical value.

Nevertheless, when retail investors see giants like Meta (META-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) pouring money into AI, it’s hard not to feel they are simply following companies that understand the technology and its impact better, and whose confidence is strong enough to justify massive spending.
Tan’s point may actually lie in a finer nuance: investors should steer clear of the "gambling‑style" speculation in AI trades, not reject the AI concept altogether.

After all, AI‑related stocks carry a huge weight in the S&P 500, and even if we keep Buffett’s "Omaha prophet" advice in mind, in today’s market it’s unlikely we can stay completely out of the picture.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉美光跌3.6%晶片股承壓 那指收低、費半連五跌
paras: 美國股市周二(13日)收低，晶片股延續近期跌勢，投資人則消化花旗集團(Citigroup)(C-US)及其他美國大型銀行喜憂參半的季度財報。
費城半導體指數下跌0.23%，連續第五個交易日走低。博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽週一將部分流入半導體產業的投資資金形容為「賭場賭博」。此外，市場傳出中國記憶體晶片廠長鑫存儲(CXMT)在技術方面取得進展，也加深市場對競爭日益激烈的憂慮。
美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)下跌3.6%，應用材料(Applied Materials)(AMAT-US)重挫近7%。博通上漲0.7%。
市場同時擔憂相關股票估值過高，週一南韓KOSPI下跌5.5%，觸及7月31日以來最低，記憶體類股承壓。
大型銀行正式拉開財報季序幕，惟花旗下跌5.6%，高盛(Goldman Sachs)(GS-US)跌0.2%，儘管兩家銀行公布的獲利均優於市場預期。
富國銀行(Wells Fargo)(WFC-US)下跌3.1%，主要因淨利息收入低於市場預期。摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)(JPM-US)下跌0.9%，該行罕見未能達到獲利預期。
蘋果(AAPL-US)盤中一度創下348.15美元歷史新高，終場上漲0.1%，收在341.27美元，市值達到4.98兆美元。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)數據，分析師平均預期，標普500指數成分股企業第三季獲利將大幅成長逾30%，主要動能來自與人工智慧(AI)相關科技公司。
市場對財報季表現強勁的預期，抵銷了部分來自美國與伊朗戰爭、債券殖利率飆升，以及高油價推升通膨的憂慮。
標普500指數在AI相關科技股帶動下，2026年以來已上漲14%。然而，該指數成分股的中位數漲幅不到5%，且超過200家成分企業今年股價下跌。
在市場預期AI領域大型企業將繳出亮眼財報背景下，標普500指數目前預估本益比不到19倍，為2023年以來最低。
費城半導體指數過去五個交易日累計下跌逾8%，但今年以來仍上漲超過70%。
標普500醫療保健指數週二下跌1.3%。嬌生(Johnson & Johnson)(JNJ-US)儘管獲利優於市場預期，股價仍重挫5.7%。
美股周二(13日)主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG + 科技五天王多收紅。Meta (META-US) 上漲2.63%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 0.088%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.30%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.43%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.37%。
費半成分股漲跌互見。輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 0.97%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 0.73%；美光 (MU-US) 下挫 3.62%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.39%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 重挫6.69%；德儀 (TXN-US) 上漲 2.17%；AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.90%。
台股 ADR 互有漲跌。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 0.17%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 0.15%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 0.71%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.24%。
企業新聞
蘋果發表首款智慧顯示器HomeView，結合7吋觸控螢幕、人臉辨識與升級版Siri AI，可辨識最多六名家庭成員，提供個人化資訊與居家控制功能，美國售價299美元。蘋果也同步推出新版Apple TV 4K、HomePod mini 2及合作開發的智慧家庭配件，擴大迎戰亞馬遜與Google。
輝達執行長黃仁勳表示，公司計劃未來一週宣布20億美元的歐洲投資案，延續過去一年已對當地投入80億美元的布局。他也在巴黎宣布對Doctolib、Genesis AI、Pigment及Entalpic等法國新創提供新資金，敦促歐洲必須加入AI競賽。
法國雲端業者Scaleway將在瑞典打造採用超微AI晶片的超級電腦，並由技嘉(2376-TW)旗下技鋼科技供應伺服器。這是Scaleway首度在法國以外建置AI超級電腦，並稱新系統將成為歐洲首座採用AMD平台的商用AI超級電腦，開放全歐洲新創、AI業者及企業使用。
華爾街分析
資產管理公司Longbow Asset Management執行長Jake Dollarhide表示，「許多投資人感到鬆了一口氣，因為市場可能開始更關注企業財報，而不是債券市場、持續高檔的油價，以及居高不下的利率。」
Walser Wealth Management投資長 Rebecca Walser表示，「這些銀行公布的數據其實依然強勁，只是市場原本的預期太高。在目前這個財報季，過高的預期對各產業的企業而言，都是一種風險。」
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉多空拉鋸！俄美柴油協議遇上中東戰火 油市漲跌互現
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: Bulls and Bears Clash as US-Russia Diesel Deal Meets Middle East Conflict, Oil Market Shows Mixed Moves
paras: 國際油價周二 (13日) 收盤漲跌互見，市場一方面評估美國與俄羅斯柴油供應協議可能增加全球燃料供應，另一方面則關注沙烏地阿拉伯與葉門胡塞武裝衝突升高，以及荷姆茲海峽周邊能源設施和油輪面臨的安全風險。
布蘭特原油 (Brent) 期貨下跌0.96美元或0.9%, 收在每桶105.69美元；美國西德州中級原油 (WTI) 期貨則上漲0.40美元或0.4%, 收在每桶94.14美元。
布蘭特原油前一交易日收在9月15日以來最高水準, WTI則升至9月24日以來最高收盤價。遠期合約也持續走強, WTI 2027年期貨連續第12個交易日創下紀錄高點, 觸及每桶84美元；布蘭特原油2027年期貨則於周一連續第4個交易日刷新紀錄, 升至每桶90美元。遠期價格走高反映市場仍擔心未來供應緊張, 即使短期原油價格受到俄羅斯柴油可能增加供應的消息牽動。
美國總統川普表示, 俄羅斯已同意恢復柴油出口, 以增加全球市場供應。不過, 川普指出, 俄羅斯柴油主要是供應全球其他市場, 並非直接供應美國。美國柴油期貨周二上漲約5%, 顯示市場對協議能否有效緩解燃料供應短缺仍抱持疑慮。
根據《華爾街日報》報導, 川普所公布的供應規模相當於俄羅斯10月每日出口略高於10萬桶柴油, 11月則約每日12.5萬桶, 並預計之後增加供應。相比之下, 俄羅斯去年柴油出口量約每日80萬桶, 顯示目前承諾增加的供應規模仍有限。美國柴油零售價格周一平均約每加侖6.27美元, 雖低於上月創下的6.53美元紀錄, 但仍較去年同期高出71%。
柴油供應緊張與俄烏戰爭及中東衝突有關。烏克蘭持續攻擊俄羅斯能源設施, 降低俄國煉油與燃料出口能力；美國與以色列對伊朗發動攻擊後, 中東燃料出口及航運也受到干擾, 進一步推高全球柴油價格。美國煉油廠雖增加柴油出口, 但產能已接近上限, 難以完全填補全球供應缺口。
俄羅斯克里姆林宮周二表示, 不認為對美出口柴油的協議與莫斯科在烏克蘭和平談判中的立場存在直接關聯。此番回應源自路透社先前報導, 指川普特使上周五曾告訴烏克蘭官員, 允許俄羅斯出口柴油是美方試圖讓莫斯科重新參與烏克蘭和平談判的一部分。川普則表示, 美國仍持續與基輔分享情報, 同時施壓烏克蘭停止攻擊俄羅斯煉油設施。
俄羅斯在2025年是全球第3大原油生產國, 排名僅次於美國與沙烏地阿拉伯。自2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後, 西方國家對俄羅斯能源實施制裁, 限制俄國石油及燃料進入全球市場, 也使國際能源供應更容易受到地緣政治事件影響。若俄烏戰爭達成協議, 俄羅斯能源出口可能進一步增加, 但柴油供應協議能否促成更廣泛的和平談判, 目前仍不明朗。
中東局勢則持續構成油價上行風險。與伊朗結盟的葉門胡塞武裝表示, 沙烏地阿拉伯周二對葉門首都沙那發動攻擊。沙烏地領導的聯軍此前警告平民遠離沙那郊區一座油品儲存設施, 隨後當地傳出空襲消息。這場衝突快速升溫, 使市場擔心能源設施遭到破壞, 進一步影響區域燃料供應。
周末期間, 胡塞武裝對沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德國際機場發動攻擊, 荷姆茲海峽附近也傳出油輪遇襲事件。路透社引述6名消息人士指出, 沙烏地阿拉伯國家石油公司沙烏地阿美 (Saudi Aramco) 總部所在的達蘭附近也傳出巨大爆炸聲。這些事件加深市場對波斯灣能源設施與航運通道安全的憂慮。
川普周二指控胡塞武裝刻意推高油價, 並警告不會忘記該組織對沙烏地阿拉伯發動的攻擊。隨著美國對伊朗戰爭擴大區域衝突, 市場擔心能源供應中斷風險將持續存在, 特別是荷姆茲海峽的航運若進一步受阻, 將對全球原油與成品油供應造成重大衝擊。
在美國與以色列於2月對伊朗發動攻擊前, 全球約20%的石油供應會經由荷姆茲海峽運輸。這條航道是中東能源出口的重要樞紐, 一旦油輪通行受到限制, 即使產油國提高產量, 也未必能迅速彌補運輸受阻造成的缺口。
石油輸出國組織及盟國 (OPEC+) 周二公布的數據顯示, 9月產量大幅增加, 主要來自沙烏地阿拉伯增產。這顯示產油國仍試圖提高供應, 但中東衝突造成的運輸風險, 可能抵銷部分增產帶來的緩解效果。OPEC+成員包括OPEC產油國及俄羅斯等盟國。
OPEC同時連續第6個月下調2026年全球石油需求成長預測, 並上調2027年需求成長預測。該組織指出, 伊朗戰爭導致全球石油庫存消耗, 未來市場需要重新補充庫存, 因此中長期需求前景仍受到補庫需求支撐。OPEC秘書長海賽姆・蓋斯 (Haitham Al Ghais) 先前表示, 組織已將2026年石油需求成長預測由年初的每日140萬桶下調至每日40萬桶, 反映今年經濟與能源市場變化。
整體而言, 國際油市目前同時受到供應增加與供應中斷風險影響。俄羅斯柴油出口若逐步恢復, 有望緩解部分成品油短缺, 但目前承諾的供應規模相對有限；另一方面, 沙烏地阿拉伯與胡塞武裝衝突、荷姆茲海峽航運風險及俄烏戰爭持續, 仍可能讓原油與柴油供應維持緊繃。後續油價走勢將取決於俄羅斯實際出口量、中東能源運輸是否恢復穩定, 以及OPEC+增產能否抵銷地緣政治風險帶來的供應損失。
paras_en: International oil prices closed mixed on Tuesday (the 13th), as the market weighed a possible US‑Russia diesel supply agreement that could boost global fuel supplies against rising Saudi‑Yemen Houthi conflict and safety risks to energy facilities and tankers around the Hormuz Strait.
Brent crude futures fell $0.96 or 0.9% to $105.69 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures rose $0.40 or 0.4% to $94.14 a barrel.

Brent closed at its highest level since September 15, and WTI hit its highest close since September 24. Forward contracts kept strengthening, with the 2027 WTI contract hitting a record high of $84 a barrel for the 12th consecutive trading day, and the 2027 Brent contract rising to $90 a barrel on its fourth straight record‑setting day. The rise in forward prices reflects lingering worries about future supply tightness, even as short‑term crude prices are being tugged by news that Russian diesel may increase supply.

U.S. President Trump said Russia has agreed to resume diesel exports to increase global market supply. However, Trump noted that Russian diesel is mainly destined for markets outside the United States. U.S. diesel futures jumped about 5% on Tuesday, showing the market remains skeptical about whether the deal will meaningfully ease fuel shortages.

According to the Wall Street Journal, the volume Trump announced corresponds to just over 100,000 barrels of diesel per day in October and about 125,000 barrels per day in November, with further increases expected. By contrast, Russia exported roughly 800,000 barrels of diesel per day last year, indicating the newly pledged volumes are modest. U.S. diesel retail prices averaged $6.27 per gallon on Monday, down from last month’s record $6.53 but still 71% higher than a year ago.

Diesel tightness is linked to the Ukraine war and Middle‑East fighting. Ukraine’s continued strikes on Russian energy facilities have reduced Russia’s refining and fuel‑export capacity; U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran have disrupted Middle‑East fuel exports and shipping, pushing global diesel prices higher. Although U.S. refineries have boosted diesel exports, their capacity is near its limit and cannot fully fill the global supply gap.

The Kremlin said on Tuesday it sees no direct link between the diesel‑export agreement with the United States and Moscow’s stance in Ukraine peace talks. The comment followed a Reuters report that a Trump envoy told Ukrainian officials last Friday that allowing Russian diesel exports was part of a U.S. effort to bring Moscow back to the negotiating table. Trump affirmed the U.S. continues to share intelligence with Kyiv while pressuring Ukraine to stop hitting Russian refineries.

Russia is the world’s third‑largest crude producer in 2025, behind the United States and Saudi Arabia. Since Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, Western sanctions have limited Russian oil and fuel from entering global markets, making energy supply more vulnerable to geopolitical events. If a Ukraine peace deal is reached, Russian energy exports could rise further, but it remains unclear whether the diesel pact will spur broader peace negotiations.

Middle‑East tensions continue to pose upward pressure on oil prices. Yemen’s Iran‑aligned Houthi rebels said Saudi Arabia attacked the Yemeni capital Sana’a on Tuesday. The Saudi‑led coalition had earlier warned civilians to stay away from a fuel‑storage site on the outskirts of Sana’a, and air‑strike reports soon followed. The rapidly escalating clash has raised fears that energy facilities could be damaged, further affecting regional fuel supplies.

Over the weekend, Houthi forces struck Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh International Airport, and a tanker was reportedly attacked near the Hormuz Strait. Reuters, citing six sources, said a massive explosion was heard near Dammam, close to Saudi Aramco’s headquarters. These incidents have deepened market worries about the safety of Persian Gulf energy infrastructure and shipping lanes.

Trump accused the Houthis on Tuesday of deliberately driving up oil prices and warned he would not forget their attacks on Saudi Arabia. As the U.S. expands its conflict with Iran, markets fear continued disruption to energy supplies, especially if Hormuz shipping becomes further constrained, which would severely impact global crude and refined‑product flows.

Before the U.S. and Israel’s February strikes on Iran, about 20% of global oil shipments passed through the Hormuz Strait, a key conduit for Middle‑East energy exports. If tanker traffic is restricted, even higher production by oil‑producing nations may not quickly offset the transport shortfall.

OPEC+ data released on Tuesday showed a sharp rise in September output, driven mainly by increased Saudi production. This indicates producers are still trying to boost supply, but transport risks from the Middle‑East conflict could offset some of the relief from higher output. OPEC+ members include OPEC producers and allies such as Russia.

OPEC also cut its 2026 global oil‑demand growth forecast for the sixth consecutive month while raising the 2027 forecast. The organization said the Iran war has depleted global oil inventories, creating a need to restock, which supports medium‑term demand. OPEC Secretary‑General Haitham Al Ghais previously noted the 2026 demand growth estimate was lowered from 1.4 million barrels per day at the start of the year to 400,000 barrels per day, reflecting this year’s economic and energy‑market shifts.

If Russian diesel exports gradually resume, they could ease some refined‑product shortages, but the pledged volumes remain limited; meanwhile, the Saudi‑Houthi clash, Hormuz shipping risks and the ongoing Ukraine war could keep crude and diesel supplies tight. paras_en: Taiwan stocks faced heavy selling pressure on the 13th, slipping throughout the session and ending below the 49,000‑point threshold at 48,341.31, down 960.65 points or 1.95%, with a turnover of NT$1.125 trillion. Foreign investors withdrew massively, net‑selling NT$165.342 billion in the spot market – the third‑largest single‑day net outflow in Taiwan market history and exceeding the total net outflows of the previous four trading days (NT$147.75 billion), indicating a clear acceleration of foreign capital exits.

The Ministry of Finance released preliminary September figures for national tax revenue on the 13th. Benefiting from lively market activity, securities transaction tax – a barometer of market trading – was collected at NT$53.4 billion for the month, up 71.2% year‑over‑year and marking the 14th consecutive month of growth. Cumulatively, tax revenue for the first nine months reached NT$3.5714 trillion, a 24.4% annual increase, with the nine‑month net collection accounting for 78.8% of the full‑year budget and the budget achievement rate hitting 115%, surpassing expectations.

Testing‑equipment giant Zhi Mao (2360‑TW) disclosed on the 12th a breach settlement case worth NT$58.595 million, bringing the total number of listed‑company settlement breaches this year to 26. The Securities and Futures Bureau of the Financial Supervisory Commission said that for the first nine months of this year, breach amounts in the spot market represented only 1.8 per 100,000 of total market turnover, indicating overall settlement order remained sound and risks were within controllable limits. Nevertheless, to guard against risks from heightened trading activity and international volatility, the Commission approved revisions to exchange rules on September 23, with the strengthened breach‑management regime slated to take effect on April 1, 2027.

Hua Nan Financial Holding (2880‑TW) reported on the 13th its self‑calculated earnings for the first three quarters, posting a net profit after tax of NT$26.367 billion – a 32.4% year‑over‑year increase – and earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.88. Return on equity (ROE) rose to 14.38%, and all key financial metrics hit historic highs for the same period. Profit growth was driven by steady performance from its banking subsidiary and a sharp surge in earnings from non‑banking units, giving the group a strong dual‑engine growth momentum and positioning full‑year profit to potentially reach a new peak.

Integrated circuit testing firm SiGe (6257‑TW) is actively expanding capacity by acquiring existing facilities. Through its subsidiary SiGe Joint Testing, the company participated in the auction of a technology park building at No. 1, Innovation 2nd Road, Hsinchu Science Park, winning the bid on the 13th with a price of NT$2.188 billion. This follows SiGe’s February acquisition of Huke’s Huguo plant assets from Unimicron (3037‑TW) for NT$1.54 billion, marking another step in expanding its operational footprint via plant purchases.
Foreign investors' single‑day net sell of NT$165.3 billion ranks as the third‑largest ever, with TSMC and memory‑chip stocks being the primary withdrawal targets.

Tax statistics: September securities transaction tax reached NT$53.4 billion, marking the 14th consecutive month of increase; total tax revenue for the first nine months hit NT$3.57 trillion, up 24% year‑over‑year.
There have been 26 listed‑company settlement breaches this year; the Financial Supervisory Commission notes that the new control regime will be implemented in April next year.
Hua Nan Financial posted a Q3 profit of NT$26.3 billion, EPS of NT$1.88, approaching last year's full‑year level and setting a new high.
SiGe Group spent NT$2.188 billion to acquire a multi‑ten‑thousand‑square‑meter technology plant in Hsinchu Science Park.
Starting tomorrow, six new stocks will be added to the watchlist; high‑flying stock Crown West Electric has surged nearly four‑fold over the past 90 trading days.
Taiwan Cement's shareholders approved the listing of its European subsidiary; Chairman Zhang An‑ping said this adds another leg to the group’s growth.

The Taiwan stock market capitalization rankings undergo a major reshuffle: Chuan‑Lake and Zhi Mao fall out of the trillion‑NTD club, while Fubon Financial climbs to a new high despite market headwinds.

The United States launches an investigation under Section 337 into alleged product infringement by Taiwanese firms; the Taiwanese Chamber of Commerce says it is not worried and remains confident in Taiwan’s technological capabilities.

Chunghwa Telecom’s asset revitalization drives EPS growth, with its "lease‑instead‑sell" model contributing sustainable recurring revenue.

paras_en: Taiwan stocks faced heavy selling pressure on the 13th, slipping throughout the session and ending below the 49,000‑point threshold at 48,341.31, down 960.65 points or 1.95%, with a turnover of NT$1.125 trillion. Foreign investors withdrew massively, net‑selling NT$165.342 billion in the spot market – the third‑largest single‑day net outflow in Taiwan market history and exceeding the total net outflows of the previous four trading days (NT$147.75 billion), indicating a clear acceleration of foreign capital exits.

The Ministry of Finance released preliminary September figures for national tax revenue on the 13th. Benefiting from lively market activity, securities transaction tax – a barometer of market trading – was collected at NT$53.4 billion for the month, up 71.2% year‑over‑year and marking the 14th consecutive month of growth. Cumulatively, tax revenue for the first nine months reached NT$3.5714 trillion, a 24.4% annual increase, with the nine‑month net collection accounting for 78.8% of the full‑year budget and the budget achievement rate hitting 115%, surpassing expectations.

Testing‑equipment giant Zhi Mao (2360‑TW) disclosed on the 12th a breach settlement case worth NT$58.595 million, bringing the total number of listed‑company settlement breaches this year to 26. The Securities and Futures Bureau of the Financial Supervisory Commission said that for the first nine months of this year, breach amounts in the spot market represented only 1.8 per 100,000 of total market turnover, indicating overall settlement order remained sound and risks were within controllable limits. Nevertheless, to guard against risks from heightened trading activity and international volatility, the Commission approved revisions to exchange rules on September 23, with the strengthened breach‑management regime slated to take effect on April 1, 2027.

Hua Nan Financial Holding (2880‑TW) reported on the 13th its self‑calculated earnings for the first three quarters, posting a net profit after tax of NT$26.367 billion – a 32.4% year‑over‑year increase – and earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.88. Return on equity (ROE) rose to 14.38%, and all key financial metrics hit historic highs for the same period. Profit growth was driven by steady performance from its banking subsidiary and a sharp surge in earnings from non‑banking units, giving the group a strong dual‑engine growth momentum and positioning full‑year profit to potentially reach a new peak.

Integrated circuit testing firm SiGe (6257‑TW) is actively expanding capacity by acquiring existing facilities. Through its subsidiary SiGe Joint Testing, the company participated in the auction of a technology park building at No. 1, Innovation 2nd Road, Hsinchu Science Park, winning the bid on the 13th with a price of NT$2.188 billion. This follows SiGe’s February acquisition of Huke’s Huguo plant assets from Unimicron (3037‑TW) for NT$1.54 billion, marking another step in expanding its operational footprint via plant purchases.
Foreign investors' single‑day net sell of NT$165.3 billion ranks as the third‑largest ever, with TSMC and memory‑chip stocks being the primary withdrawal targets.

Tax statistics: September securities transaction tax reached NT$53.4 billion, marking the 14th consecutive month of increase; total tax revenue for the first nine months hit NT$3.57 trillion, up 24% year‑over‑year.
There have been 26 listed‑company settlement breaches this year; the Financial Supervisory Commission notes that the new control regime will be implemented in April next year.
Hua Nan Financial posted a Q3 profit of NT$26.3 billion, EPS of NT$1.88, approaching last year's full‑year level and setting a new high.
SiGe Group spent NT$2.188 billion to acquire a multi‑ten‑thousand‑square‑meter technology plant in Hsinchu Science Park.
Starting tomorrow, six new stocks will be added to the watchlist; high‑flying stock Crown West Electric has surged nearly four‑fold over the past 90 trading days.
Taiwan Cement's shareholders approved the listing of its European subsidiary; Chairman Zhang An‑ping said this adds another leg to the group’s growth.

The Taiwan stock market capitalization rankings undergo a major reshuffle: Chuan‑Lake and Zhi Mao fall out of the trillion‑NTD club, while Fubon Financial climbs to a new high despite market headwinds.

The United States launches an investigation under Section 337 into alleged product infringement by Taiwanese firms; the Taiwanese Chamber of Commerce says it is not worried and remains confident in Taiwan’s technological capabilities.

items.title: AI晶片變強不只靠製程！先進封裝成新關鍵 台積電布局受矚目
items.title_en: Advanced Packaging Becomes the New Key to Stronger AI Chips, Not Just Process Technology
paras: AI晶片競爭正從「電晶體能做多小」，延伸至「不同晶片如何整合」。隨著先進製程微縮難度與成本攀升，將多塊晶片緊密連接的先進封裝技術，正成為提升效能的重要途徑，也讓台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)在AI供應鏈中的角色更加關鍵。
據《華爾街日報》報導，過去晶片進步主要依賴電晶體設計與尺寸縮小，如今則愈來愈仰賴晶片的排列、連接及堆疊方式。這項轉變已醞釀多年，AI運算需求爆發，更讓先進封裝成為半導體競爭焦點。

製程微縮難度升高 多晶片整合兼顧成本與良率

數十年來，半導體業依循英特爾(INTC-US)共同創辦人摩爾(Gordon Moore)提出的觀察，讓單一晶片上的電晶體數量大致每兩年倍增，形成著名的「摩爾定律」，並持續提升效能與能源效率。
然而，過去十多年，隨著電晶體縮小至奈米尺度，這項規律開始受到挑戰。英特爾等業者難以維持過往製程推進速度，即使台積電持續推進技術，每一代電晶體密度的提升幅度，也已不如以往巨大。
最先進製程成本快速攀升，更促使超微(AMD-US)與英特爾早在AI熱潮前，就改變大型中央處理器的設計方式：不再將所有電路集中於一整塊昂貴晶片，而是整合多塊晶片，部分採用較成熟、成本較低的製程，同時改善生產良率。
這類先進封裝技術，讓晶片效能提升不必完全依賴製程微縮，也使不同功能的晶片能以更靈活的方式組合。

輝達AI晶片仰賴先進封裝 下一步走向立體堆疊

AI浪潮則讓封裝競賽進一步加速。對輝達(NVDA-US)而言，研發AI晶片時，成本並非最主要考量，效能才是重點；但若沒有先進封裝，其領先市場的晶片也難以製造。
輝達採用台積電開發的技術，在同一個先進封裝內整合強大的AI運算晶片與大量高頻寬記憶體(HBM)。封裝產能擴張受限，曾成為輝達銷售成長的瓶頸。台積電近年已將舊晶圓廠轉作封裝設施，並將相關產能擴增數倍。
台積電將於周四公布季度財報，持續與客戶合作突破晶片製造限制的封裝布局，也受到關注。未來技術不只把晶片並排連接，而是更進一步將多塊晶片上下堆疊，朝立體整合發展。
封裝過去被視為毛利較低、創新相對有限的業務，如今地位正在改變。台積電等晶片製造商擴大自行承作，將過去多交由外部業者處理的工作納入內部，設備商也看好相關商機。
應用材料(AMAT-US)執行長Gary Dickerson於8月表示，公司今年封裝相關營收預計成長逾70%，凸顯先進封裝不僅改變晶片設計，也正在帶動半導體設備的新需求。
paras_en: AI chip competition is shifting from "how small transistors can be" to "how different chips can be integrated". As advanced process miniaturization becomes more difficult and costly, advanced packaging that tightly connects multiple chips is becoming a crucial way to boost performance, making TSMC (2330‑TW) even more central in the AI supply chain.

According to a Wall Street Journal report, chip progress in the past relied mainly on transistor design and size reduction, but now increasingly depends on how chips are arranged, connected, and stacked. This shift has been brewing for years, and the explosive demand for AI computing has made advanced packaging the focal point of semiconductor competition.

Over decades, the semiconductor industry has followed the observation of Intel co‑founder Gordon Moore, that the number of transistors on a single chip roughly doubles every two years, forming the famous "Moore’s Law" and continuously improving performance and energy efficiency.

However, in the past decade, as transistors shrink to the nanometer scale, this law has begun to be challenged. Intel and others have struggled to maintain the pace of process advancement, and even though TSMC continues to push technology, the increase in transistor density per generation is no longer as dramatic as before.

The cost of the most advanced processes rises rapidly, prompting AMD and Intel to change their large CPU designs even before the AI boom: they no longer concentrate all circuits on one expensive chip but integrate multiple chips, some using more mature, lower‑cost processes, while improving yield.
These advanced packaging techniques allow chip performance to improve without relying entirely on process miniaturization, and enable different functional chips to be combined more flexibly.

The AI wave has accelerated the packaging race. For NVIDIA, cost is not the primary concern when developing AI chips; performance is. But without advanced packaging, even its leading market chips would be hard to manufacture.

NVIDIA uses TSMC‑developed technology to integrate powerful AI compute chips and large high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) within the same advanced package. Packaging capacity expansion has been limited, becoming a bottleneck for NVIDIA’s sales growth. TSMC has recently converted old wafer fabs into packaging facilities and increased related capacity severalfold.

TSMC will announce its quarterly earnings on Thursday, and its continued collaboration with customers to break chip manufacturing limits through packaging is attracting attention. Future technology will not only connect chips side‑by‑side but will stack multiple chips vertically, moving toward 3‑D integration.

Packaging was once seen as a low‑margin, relatively low‑innovation business, but its status is changing. TSMC and other chip makers are expanding in‑house fabrication, taking on work that was previously outsourced, and equipment suppliers are optimistic about the related opportunities.

Gary Dickerson, CEO of Applied Materials, said in August that the company’s packaging revenue is expected to grow more than 70% this year, highlighting that advanced packaging is not only changing chip design but also driving new demand for semiconductor equipment.

items.title: 華南金前3季賺263億元直逼去年全年 EPS 1.88元同創新高
items.title_en: Hua Nan Financial Posts NT$26.367 Billion Profit in First Three Quarters, Nearing Full-Year Figure; EPS Hits NT$1.88, New High
paras: 華南金控 (2880-TW) 今 (13) 日公布自結獲利，前3季稅後純益達263.67億元，年增32.4%，每股純益 (EPS) 達1.88元，年化股東權益報酬率 (ROE) 攀升至14.38%，財務指標均刷新歷史同期新高紀錄；獲利成長主要得益於銀行子公司保持穩健，加上非銀行子公司獲利大幅躍升，集團雙引擎成長動能強勁，全年獲利有望順利登頂再創新高。

華南金表示，9月單月稅後純益為23.45億元，前3季累計獲利263.67億元，已極度接近去年全年的264.2億元水準。從獲利結構來看，銀行子公司前3季獲利年增24.3億元，成長13.1%，占集團獲利比重77%；非銀行子公司表現極為亮眼，包括證券、產險、創投、AMC及投信等，合計年增40.34億元，年幅高達170%，累計獲利占比一舉由去年同期的11%提升至23%，增加12個百分點，整體獲利結構更為均衡穩健。
子公司華南銀行9月稅後純益為19.96億元，前3季稅後純益累計達209.87億元，年增13.1%，維持穩健成長走勢。9月獲利較8月回落，主要因股利旺季進入尾聲使股利收入減少，以及美聯儲升息影響既有SWAP（換匯交易）部位兌換收益；隨著新承作SWAP收益條件改善，第4季金融操作收益表現可望回溫。
華南銀行前3季利息、手續費及金融操作三大核心收益同步揚升。在調整存放款結構展現效益下，第3季放款較前季大增1693億元，季增7%，淨利息收益率 (NIM) 同步提升5bps，帶動利息淨收益年增12%；財務操作策略靈活，帶動投資淨收益年增3%；財富管理業務在基金、保險與外國債帶動下暴增32%，推升總手續費淨收益突破138億元，年增29%。
海外佈局方面，華南銀行OBU與海外分行前3季獲利達43.7億元，年增34%，占銀行稅後淨利21%，其中OBU分行獲利更大幅成長126%。因應台商全球供應鏈重組商機，華南銀將持續透過海外分行及OBU提供全球一條龍金融服務，擴大海外獲利版圖。
證券與產險子公司同樣繳出優異成績單。華南永昌證券9月稅後純益2.63億元，前3季稅後純益達42.48億元，年增高達215%。經紀、承銷及自營三大核心業務均大幅成長，其中前3季經紀手續費收入達60.33億元，年增110%；承銷業務收入達8.34億元，年增443%；自營投資獲利達11.01億元，年增180%。海外複委託交易熱度延續，前3季累計交易量突破2660億元，年增127%。
華南產險9月稅後純益1.69億元，前3季稅後純益16.75億元，年增32%，主要受惠商業火險及工程險業務成長，損失率改善推升核保利潤，且網路投保保費較去年同期成長11.82%，展現數位轉型效益。
華南金創投9月稅後純益0.52億元，前3季稅後純益3.49億元、EPS為1.74元，雙創歷史同期新高，主要是抓緊股市上揚時機處分持股实现利益，加上國內經濟與出口動能強勁帶動投資組合績效。
華南金控及旗下銀行、證券、產險、創投等4家子公司，前3季稅後淨利與EPS均改寫歷史同期新高；金控、證券、產險及創投的年化ROE亦同步刷新紀錄，展現集團多元經營與高資本效益的亮眼成果。
paras_en: Hua Nan Financial Holding (2880‑TW) announced today (13th) its unaudited earnings, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$26.367 billion for the first three quarters, up 32.4% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.88. The annualised return on equity (ROE) rose to 14.38%, and all financial metrics hit historic highs for the same period; profit growth was driven by a solid banking subsidiary and a sharp rise in earnings from non‑bank subsidiaries, giving the group strong dual‑engine momentum and raising expectations that full‑year profit could top previous records.

In September alone, net profit after tax was NT$2.345 billion, and the cumulative profit for the first three quarters reached NT$26.367 billion, almost matching last year’s full‑year total of NT$26.42 billion. Looking at the profit composition, the banking subsidiary contributed NT$24.3 billion of profit growth for the quarter, a 13.1% increase and accounting for 77% of the group’s earnings. Non‑bank subsidiaries—securities, property‑casualty insurance, venture capital, asset‑management companies and mutual funds—shone brightly, together adding NT$4.034 billion, a 170% year‑on‑year surge, raising their share of total profit from 11% to 23%, a 12‑percentage‑point jump and making the overall profit structure more balanced and robust.

The subsidiary Hua Nan Bank posted a September net profit after tax of NT$1.996 billion, and its cumulative profit for the first three quarters reached NT$20.987 billion, up 13.1% year‑on‑year, maintaining a steady growth trajectory. September’s profit fell short of August’s mainly because the dividend‑paying season was winding down, reducing dividend income, and because Federal Reserve rate hikes affected the earnings from existing swap positions; with improved conditions for new swap deals, financial‑operation earnings are expected to rebound in Q4.

Hua Nan Bank’s three core revenue streams—interest, fees and financial operations—rose in tandem during the first three quarters. After adjusting its loan‑deposit structure, loan disbursements jumped NT$169.3 billion in Q3, a 7% quarterly increase, while the net interest margin (NIM) rose by 5 basis points, driving a 12% year‑on‑year rise in net interest income. Flexible financial‑operation strategies lifted net investment income by 3% year‑on‑year, and wealth‑management revenue surged 32% on the back of funds, insurance and foreign bonds, pushing total net fee income past NT$13.8 billion, up 29% year‑on‑year.

On the overseas front, Hua Nan Bank’s overseas business unit (OBU) and foreign branches generated NT$4.37 billion in profit for the first three quarters, a 34% increase and representing 21% of the bank’s net profit after tax, with the OBU alone posting a 126% profit jump. In response to the global supply‑chain restructuring opportunities for Taiwanese firms, Hua Nan Bank will continue to leverage its overseas branches and OBU to provide end‑to‑end financial services, expanding its overseas profit footprint.

The securities and property‑casualty insurance subsidiaries also delivered outstanding results. Hua Nan Yong‑Chang Securities reported a September net profit after tax of NT$263 million, and a cumulative profit of NT$4.248 billion for the first three quarters, a 215% year‑on‑year increase. Brokerage, underwriting and proprietary trading—all core businesses—grew sharply, with brokerage fee income reaching NT$6.033 billion (up 110% YoY), underwriting revenue NT$834 million (up 443% YoY), and proprietary investment profit NT$1.101 billion (up 180% YoY). Overseas “re‑commissioned” trading remained hot, with total transaction volume exceeding NT$266 billion for the quarter, up 127% year‑on‑year.

Hua Nan Property‑Casualty Insurance posted a September net profit after tax of NT$169 million and a cumulative profit of NT$1.675 billion for the first three quarters, up 32% year‑on‑year, driven by growth in commercial fire and engineering insurance lines, an improved loss ratio that boosted underwriting profit, and online premium sales that rose 11.82% from the same period last year, showcasing the benefits of its digital transformation.

Hua Nan Financial’s venture‑capital arm recorded a September net profit after tax of NT$52 million, and a cumulative profit of NT$3.49 billion for the first three quarters, with EPS of NT$1.74, both hitting historic highs for the same period. The performance stemmed from capitalising on a rising stock market to realise gains on holdings, together with strong domestic economic and export momentum that lifted portfolio returns.

Overall, Hua Nan Financial Holding and its four subsidiaries—banking, securities, property‑casualty insurance and venture capital—set new historic highs for net profit after tax and EPS in the first three quarters; the annualised ROE for the holding company, securities, insurance and venture‑capital units also reached record levels, highlighting the group’s diversified operations and high capital efficiency.

items.title: AI Agent將走進LINE服務 目標明年Q1推出AI代理平台
items.title_en: AI Agent to Enter LINE Services, Aiming to Launch AI Agent Platform in Q1 Next Year
paras: LINE今(13)日舉辦年度記者會 LINE CONVERGE 2026，以「Connect the Next」為主軸，從連結人與人的日常溝通出發，延伸到面對品牌與店家，並積極強化平台防護及公私協力。下一階段以「Life on LINE with AI」為創新發展方向，結合代理式 AI，提升聊天室體驗，串聯生態系服務，預計2027年第一季推出AI代理平台。
LINE 台灣董事長暨執行長陳立人表示，不僅是 AI Agent，而是將 Agentic AI 無縫融入 LINE 原本就有的各項服務裡，讓用戶不需要重新適應新的使用方式，而是在最熟悉的 LINE 裡，輕鬆地交待任務，讓 AI 代為完成。
因此LINE 官方帳號將邁入 AI 代理時代，目標於2027年第一季推出「AI 代理平台」，讓品牌可直接在官方帳號中打造專屬 AI Agent，透過 AI 理解顧客需求、串聯資訊與服務流程，並協助完成任務，讓每一次對話更靠近生意轉換。
LINE進一步說明， AI Agent 進入聊天室，可直接在聊天室中提供協助，協助群組成員搞定原本需要外部搜尋或額外整理的資訊。同時，也能串聯生活服務，首波鎖定「吃、玩、買」三面向。
AI Agent所串聯的服務，除了LINE 自有生態系，現正更積極招募跨界合作夥伴加入，讓用戶能透過 LINE 更便捷地探索與取得所需服務，同時協助品牌與商家精準掌握需求、拓展接觸點，進一步發揮 LINE 生態系的串聯價值。
另外，Line於會中揭露最新台灣用戶使用數據，在語音與視訊通話方面，用戶每日平均撥出2.6次通話，語音與視訊通話時間分別超過20.2分鐘與23.5分鐘；LINE 社群也累積1350萬月活躍用戶及45萬個月活躍聊天室，顯見除了好友關係以外，基於共同興趣或主題的『非熟人社交』也高度活躍。
paras_en: LINE held its annual press conference, LINE CONVERGE 2026, today (13th) under the theme “Connect the Next,” focusing on linking everyday communication between people, extending to brands and merchants, and actively strengthening platform security and public‑private cooperation. The next phase, “Life on LINE with AI,” will drive innovation by integrating agent‑style AI to enhance chatroom experiences and connect ecosystem services, with an AI agent platform slated for launch in the first quarter of 2027.

LINE Taiwan Chairman and CEO Chen Liren said it is not just an AI Agent, but the seamless integration of agentic AI into LINE’s existing services, allowing users to continue using the familiar LINE interface while easily assigning tasks for the AI to handle.

Consequently, LINE official accounts will enter the AI agent era, targeting a first‑quarter 2027 rollout of an “AI Agent Platform” that lets brands create dedicated AI Agents within their official accounts, using AI to understand customer needs, link information and service flows, and assist in task completion, making each conversation closer to business conversion.

LINE further explained that AI Agents entering chatrooms can provide direct assistance, helping group members obtain information that would otherwise require external searches or extra organization. They will also connect to lifestyle services, with the first wave focusing on “eat, play, and shop.”

The services linked by AI Agents will go beyond LINE’s own ecosystem; the company is actively recruiting cross‑industry partners so users can more conveniently explore and obtain needed services via LINE, while helping brands and merchants precisely capture demand and expand touchpoints, further leveraging the connective value of the LINE ecosystem.

Additionally, LINE disclosed the latest Taiwan user statistics at the event: on average, users make 2.6 voice or video calls per day, with voice call duration exceeding 20.2 minutes and video call duration over 23.5 minutes. LINE communities have amassed 13.5 million monthly active users and 450,000 monthly active chatrooms, indicating that “non‑acquaintance social” interactions based on shared interests or topics are highly active beyond just friend relationships.

items.title: 矽格集團斥21.88億元 拿下建漢竹科園區萬坪科技廠房
items.title_en: Siliconware Group Spends NT$2.188 Billion to Acquire a Ten-Thousand-Ping Technology Plant in Hsinchu Science Park
paras: IC封測廠矽格(6257-TW)積極透過取得既有廠房擴充產能，矽格透過子公司矽格聯測參與新竹科學園區創新二路1號科技廠房標售，今(13)日以21.88億元得標。這是矽格集團繼今年2月以15.4億元向欣興(3037-TW)取得湖口廠資產後，再度透過購置廠房擴大營運布局。
此次標售的科技廠房原屬建漢科技(3062-TW)，位於新竹科學園區創新二路1號，占地約7,870坪，建物面積約1萬4,215坪，具備進一步擴充生產規模的空間。
矽格表示，取得新廠房後，將進一步提升服務美系大客戶的能力，鎖定AI及AI Connectivity、CPU、GPU、ASIC與AI加速器等高效能運算(HPC)晶片測試需求，持續強化先進測試布局。
在新廠規劃方面，矽格將聚焦AI互連、矽光子及高速光通訊IC的測試設備研發與測試服務，同時布局AI ASIC晶圓及CoWoS晶片測試，並兼顧通用型IC測試與後段服務。透過自主研發測試設備，結合測試服務整合，矽格將進一步提升先進測試技術能力。
矽格預估，新購廠房未來投入量產後，可使整體產能較現有量產廠區增加約25%，有助於因應客戶多元化需求，並擴大高階晶片測試服務量能。
此次取得的新廠，也是矽格持續擴充產能布局的一環。隨著湖口二廠預計於2026年下半年投入量產、中興三廠預計於2027年初接續投產，再加上此次取得的廠房，矽格將逐步建立更完整的產能梯隊，提供客戶兼具成本與技術優勢的測試解決方案，挹注長期營運成長動能。
隨著AI、高效能運算及先進封裝需求升溫，IC封測業者持續加碼產能投資，日月光投控(3711-TW)旗下矽品等業者也積極擴充產能，顯示業界正加速布局高階晶片測試與封裝商機。
paras_en: IC testing firm Siliconware (6257-TW) is actively expanding capacity by acquiring existing facilities. Through its subsidiary Siliconware Joint Test, the company participated in the auction of the technology plant at No. 1 Innovation 2nd Road, Hsinchu Science Park, and won the bid today (the 13th) with a price of NT$2.188 billion. This follows the group's February acquisition of the Hukou plant assets from Unimicron (3037-TW) for NT$1.54 billion, marking another expansion of its operational footprint via plant purchases.

The technology plant up for auction originally belonged to Jenhan Technology (3062-TW). It is located at No. 1 Innovation 2nd Road, Hsinchu Science Park, covering about 7,870 ping of land with a building area of roughly 14,215 ping, providing space for further production scale expansion.

Siliconware said that after acquiring the new plant, it will further enhance its ability to serve major U.S. customers, targeting testing demand for AI and AI connectivity, CPUs, GPUs, ASICs and AI accelerators, and continue to strengthen its advanced testing layout.

Regarding the new plant's plan, Siliconware will focus on developing test equipment and services for AI interconnect, silicon photonics, and high‑speed optical communication ICs, while also positioning AI ASIC wafers and CoWoS chip testing, and maintaining support for general‑purpose IC testing and back‑end services. By independently developing test equipment and integrating testing services, the company aims to further boost its advanced testing technology capabilities.

Siliconware estimates that once the newly purchased plant goes into mass production, overall capacity will increase by about 25% compared with its existing production sites, helping meet diversified customer needs and expanding high‑end chip testing service volume.

The newly acquired plant is part of Siliconware's ongoing capacity‑expansion strategy. With the Hukou Phase‑2 plant expected to start mass production in the second half of 2026, the Zhongxing Phase‑3 plant slated for early 2027, and now this additional facility, Siliconware will gradually build a more complete capacity ladder, offering customers testing solutions that combine cost and technology advantages, thereby fueling long‑term operational growth.

As AI, high‑performance computing and advanced packaging demand heat up, IC testing companies continue to invest heavily in capacity. Companies such as ASE Technology Holding (3711-TW) and its subsidiary Siliconware Precision are also actively expanding capacity, indicating that the industry is accelerating its layout of high‑end chip testing and packaging opportunities.

items.title: 波士頓Fed總裁柯林斯：今年底前仍可能再升息
items.title_en: Boston Fed President Collins: Another Rate Hike May Still Be Possible Before Year-End
paras: 《路透社》報導，波士頓聯準銀行(Fed)總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)週二(13日)表示，為了降低居高不下的通膨，美國央行今年底前可能還需要再次升息。
柯林斯表示，她支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上個月的升息決策，目前仍認為，「為確保通膨能及時且持續地回到委員會設定的2%目標，今年底前進一步小幅升息將是適當的做法。」
她在波士頓聯準銀行一場銀行業會議的演講中指出，「我是否認為有必要進一步採取貨幣政策行動，以及採取行動的適當時機，將在很大程度上取決於接下來公布的各項數據如何影響我的經濟展望，以及相關風險的平衡。」
柯林斯表示，目前美國經濟與就業市場表現良好，聯準會因此能夠將工作重心放在降低通膨、使其回到目標水準。過去五年多來，聯準會一直未能達成這項通膨目標。
聯準會上個月將政策利率調升0.25個百分點，使利率區間升至3.75%至4.00%。
聯準會官員在當次會議公布的利率預測顯示，2026年底前還會再升息一次。不過，近幾週已有多名官員強烈暗示，下一次升息可能會在12月進行，而非10月27日至28日的會議。
柯林斯對經濟前景整體持樂觀看法，但也承認其中存在風險。
她表示，最有可能出現的情境「仍是國內生產毛額(GDP)維持健康成長，就業市場則接近充分就業」。在這種情境下，隨著效率持續提升，有助於維持供給與需求之間的平衡，並降低通膨壓力，通膨率將逐步回到 2%。
然而，她指出，科技業為建置人工智慧(AI)基礎設施而增加的投資，以及關稅與中東戰爭推升能源成本所帶來的持續影響，都可能使降低通膨的工作更加複雜。
柯林斯補充，「考量到近期航空燃油、柴油及家庭取暖用油等精煉能源產品價格大幅上漲，我預期未來幾個月，整體通膨率與核心通膨率都將再次高於聯準會設定的2%目標。」
paras_en: Reuters reported that Boston Federal Reserve Bank President Susan Collins said on Tuesday (the 13th) that, to bring down persistently high inflation, the U.S. central bank may need to raise rates again before the end of the year.

Collins said she supports the Federal Open Market Committee’s rate‑hike decision last month and still believes that, to ensure inflation returns promptly and sustainably to the Committee’s 2% target, a modest further increase before year‑end would be appropriate.

Speaking at a banking‑industry conference hosted by the Boston Fed, she noted that whether further monetary‑policy action is needed and the timing of such action will largely depend on how upcoming data shape her economic outlook and the balance of associated risks.

Collins said the U.S. economy and labor market are performing well, allowing the Fed to keep its focus on lowering inflation back to target levels. Over the past five‑plus years, the Fed has repeatedly missed that inflation goal.
The Fed raised its policy rate by a quarter‑percentage point last month, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%.

Rate‑forecast figures released at that meeting indicated another hike could occur before the end of 2026, but in recent weeks several officials have strongly hinted that the next increase may come in December rather than at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting.
Collins remains broadly optimistic about the economic outlook, though she acknowledges there are risks.

She said the most likely scenario is that GDP continues to grow healthily while the labor market stays near full employment; in that environment, rising efficiency should help keep supply and demand balanced and ease inflation pressure, gradually bringing the inflation rate back to 2%.

However, she warned that increased investment in AI infrastructure by the tech sector, as well as higher energy costs driven by tariffs and the Middle‑East war, could make the task of lowering inflation more complicated.

Collins added that, given the recent sharp rise in prices for refined energy products such as jet fuel, diesel and home heating oil, she expects overall inflation and core inflation to remain above the Fed’s 2% target for the next several months.

items.title: 長鑫新技術打崩美光、SanDisk？瑞穗列七大理由勸別急著賣
items.title_en: New Technology from ChangXin Challenges Micron, SanDisk? Mizuho Lists Seven Reasons Not to Rush to Sell
paras: 中國長鑫儲存(688825-CN) 宣稱，將於年底前推出採用4F²記憶單元設計的DDR5 RDIMM，記憶單元面積縮小約三分之一。不過，瑞穗科技、媒體與電信（TMT）產業專家Jordan Klein表示，這項消息並未改變美光科技(MU-US) 、SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 或三星電子(005930KS) 投資人的短期投資判斷。
Klein在致客戶報告中寫道：「如果我持有美光、SanDisk、SK海力士或三星，不會因為長鑫高層昨天談到新一代先進DDR5設計藍圖，就拋售持股或陷入恐慌。在我看來，這並未改變短期局勢。這件事值得密切追蹤，但也僅止於此。」
長鑫這項技術藍圖的核心，是結合4F²記憶單元架構與垂直環繞閘極電晶體的DDR5 RDIMM，目標於2026年底前推出產品。
根據瑞穗對長鑫說法的整理，這款記憶單元的面積，將比目前DDR5採用的6F²設計縮小約三分之一。
Klein提出七項理由，說明這項消息為何遠不足以構成競爭威脅。其中最關鍵的是時程比較基準不同：據報導，三星同類4F² DRAM技術的量產目標為2028年，長鑫則宣稱將於2026年底前推出產品。
Klein認為，這兩項里程碑無法直接比較。他寫道：「年底推出產品，不能直接拿來與外界報導的三星2028年量產目標相比。產品亮相，並不代表製造成熟度、良率或成本競爭力已獲得驗證。」
對於令部分記憶體投資人不安的供給過剩疑慮，Klein同樣抱持懷疑態度。他指出：「長鑫尚未證明其4F²產品已成功量產，也未提供經驗證的良率與效能，因此現在就認定供給即將過剩，還言之過早。」
長鑫尚未公布這款4F²伺服器RDIMM的完整規格、經驗證的良率、客戶認證結果，或商業規模的出貨承諾。
Klein也反駁記憶單元面積縮小就必然降低晶片成本的假設，指出製程複雜度、良率與整合等因素，都會影響最終成本，而長鑫尚未證明在這些方面已具備與競爭對手相當的實力。
他進一步強調，這款產品屬於傳統伺服器DRAM，並非高頻寬記憶體（HBM）。HBM採用堆疊式記憶體架構，是以GPU與ASIC為核心的AI加速器機櫃的重要組成部分。
這項差異意味著，長鑫短期內對AI運算基礎建設擴張的影響有限，而這波建設熱潮正是推升主要記憶體供應商估值溢價的動力。
值得注意的是，布局4F²技術並非中國獨有。瑞穗指出，三星與SK海力士也在推進類似的DDR5 4F²設計，意味著這項技術是整個產業的轉型方向，而非中國獨有的突破。
據稱，Digitimes一篇被Klein形容為「較為平衡」的報導，也對長鑫宣稱的技術進展潑了冷水，進一步支持他的審慎看法。
不過，Klein並未全盤否定長鑫的長期競爭潛力。他寫道：「不能輕忽長鑫，也不能輕忽其NAND同業長江存儲（YMTC），我也沒有這麼做。」他並補充，長鑫正積極投資，以向中國國內客戶供應傳統DRAM及更先進的記憶體。
paras_en: China ChangXin Storage (688825-CN) announced it will launch a DDR5 RDIMM using a 4F² memory cell design by the end of the year, shrinking the cell area by about one‑third. However, Mizuho Technology, Media and Telecom (TMT) expert Jordan Klein said the news does not change short‑term investment judgments for investors in Micron (MU-US), SanDisk (SNDKV-US), SK Hynix (000660KS) or Samsung Electronics (005930KS).

Klein wrote in a client report: “If I hold Micron, SanDisk, SK Hynix or Samsung, I would not dump my shares or panic just because ChangXin’s senior management talked about a new advanced DDR5 design blueprint yesterday. In my view, this does not alter the short‑term landscape. The matter is worth close monitoring, but that’s all.”

The core of ChangXin’s technology blueprint is a DDR5 RDIMM that combines a 4F² memory cell architecture with vertically wrapped gate transistors, with a target to bring the product to market by the end of 2026.
According to Mizuho’s summary of ChangXin’s statements, the memory cell area will be about one‑third smaller than the current 6F² design used in DDR5 today.

Klein listed seven reasons why the news falls far short of constituting a competitive threat. The most critical is that the timing benchmarks differ: reports say Samsung’s comparable 4F² DRAM aims for mass production in 2028, while ChangXin claims to launch a product by the end of 2026.

Klein argues the two milestones cannot be compared directly. He wrote: “A product debut at year‑end cannot be directly measured against Samsung’s reported 2028 mass‑production target. A product appearance does not prove manufacturing maturity, yield, or cost competitiveness.”

Regarding some memory investors’ worries about oversupply, Klein is equally skeptical. He noted: “ChangXin has not proven that its 4F² product is in volume production, nor provided verified yield and performance data, so it is premature to claim an imminent supply glut.”
ChangXin has not released the full specifications, verified yields, customer qualification results, or commercial‑scale shipment commitments for this 4F² server RDIMM.

Klein also refutes the assumption that a smaller cell area automatically reduces chip cost, pointing out that process complexity, yield, and integration factors all affect final cost, and ChangXin has not demonstrated parity with rivals in these areas yet.

He further emphasizes that the product is a conventional server DRAM, not high‑bandwidth memory (HBM). HBM uses a stacked memory architecture and is a key component of AI accelerator racks built around GPUs and ASICs.

This distinction means ChangXin’s short‑term impact on AI compute infrastructure expansion is limited, and the current AI build‑out wave is what is driving valuation premiums for the major memory suppliers.

It is noteworthy that the 4F² roadmap is not unique to China. Mizuho points out that Samsung and SK Hynix are also pursuing similar DDR5 4F² designs, indicating the technology is an industry‑wide transition rather than a China‑only breakthrough.
According to a Digitimes article that Klein described as “relatively balanced,” the report also poured cold water on ChangXin’s claimed progress, further supporting his cautious view.

However, Klein does not dismiss ChangXin’s long‑term competitive potential entirely. He wrote: “We cannot overlook ChangXin, nor can we overlook its NAND peer Yangtze Memory (YMTC); I do not do either.” He added that ChangXin is actively investing to supply traditional DRAM and more advanced memory to domestic Chinese customers.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元自18個月高點回落 油價下跌、通膨數據受矚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slides from 18-Month High as Oil Prices Fall, Inflation Data in Focus
paras: 美元周二(13日)自18個月高點滑落，隨著油價下跌，加上市場重新評估今年支撐美國資產需求、由人工智慧(AI)題材帶動的漲勢。投資人同時等待更多有關聯準會(Fed)利率政策走向的線索。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.37%，報102.18。該指數週一曾升至102.61，創2025年4月以來最高。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta表示，「隨著市場對AI相關股票估值的合理性及漲勢能否持續產生更多疑慮，美元正走弱。這可能抑制流入美國金融市場的資金。」
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，他仍預期今年會再升息一次，但認為2027年沒有必要進一步升息。此番言論公布後，美元跌幅進一步擴大。
市場預期，美國總統川普將避免中東局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能損害他在下個月期中選舉前的政治支持度。
川普上週表示，美國不會在選舉前攻擊伊朗，他也在週日提及俄羅斯與烏克蘭之間的能源停火安排。
週二油價下跌0.75%，至每桶105.87 美元，交易人士正評估俄羅斯是否可能額外增加柴油供應。俄羅斯表示，其柴油出口量可恢復至高於川普在與莫斯科達成的協議中所提及水準。
分析師指出，除了能源因素之外，市場對AI帶動投資的前景日益存疑，也正在挑戰近期美元漲勢。
投資人正等待週三公布的美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)，這項數據將進一步提供聯準會未來是否收緊貨幣政策的線索。
在兩名聯準會官員主張應蒐集更多證據，再決定是否有必要進一步緊縮政策後，投資人已放棄對本月稍晚升息的押注。
芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員預期聯準會在10月27至28日會議上維持利率不變的機率約為80%，高於一個月前的51%。另一方面，市場目前預期截至2027年底，聯準會累計緊縮幅度約為75個基點。
渣打銀行全球G10外匯研究主管暨北美宏觀策略主管Steven Englander表示，「我們認為通膨數據可能會略低於預期。油價仍帶來一些數據公布前的風險，但推升核心通膨的部分因素正在消退。關稅已經是去年的話題了。」
近期油價上漲曾支撐美元，並使歐元、日元等貨幣承壓，因歐元區與日本的經濟對進口石油的依賴程度遠高於美國。
歐元反彈 儘管天然氣價格升高
儘管天然氣價格再度大漲，而天然氣是推升歐元區通膨的重要因素之一，加上法國財政前景仍令人擔憂，歐元仍從約17個月低點反彈。
歐元兌美元上漲0.40%，至1歐元兌1.1198 美元。週一歐元曾跌至1.11525美元，為2025年5月以來最低。
Englander表示，「歐洲各國公債殖利率利差略有收斂。就市場對法國財政脆弱性的看法而言，我們還沒有到達最高警戒狀態，相關擔憂已經有所緩和。」
歐洲天然氣價格升至2022年12月以來最高水準，最新報價為每百萬瓦時86.74歐元。
日本銀行(BoJ)公布數據顯示，日本9月批發物價年增率為6.8%，低於市場預估中位數的7.6%。儘管如此，數據仍足以支撐市場對日本利率可能進一步上升的擔憂。日元兌美元升值0.18%，至158.33日元兌1美元。
投資人仍認為，日銀進一步收緊貨幣政策的可能性，以及官方可能出手干預過度的匯率波動，將為日元提供支撐。
澳幣兌美元報0.69830美元。此前，澳洲央行(RBA)公布9月會議紀錄，顯示委員會一致同意今年第四度升息。

paras_en: The dollar slipped from its 18‑month peak on Tuesday (the 13th) as oil prices fell and the market reassessed this year’s demand for U.S. assets, which had been buoyed by AI‑related themes. Investors are also waiting for more clues on the Federal Reserve’s rate‑policy direction.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.37% to 102.18. The index had risen to 102.61 on Monday, its highest level since April 2025.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said, “As the market grows more skeptical about the valuation and sustainability of AI‑related stocks, the dollar is weakening. This could curb capital flows into U.S. financial markets.”

New York Fed Bank President John Williams said he still expects one more rate hike this year but sees no need for further tightening in 2027. The dollar’s decline widened after his comments were released.
The market expects President Trump to avoid a further escalation in the Middle East, as a larger conflict could damage his political support ahead of next month’s mid‑term elections.
Trump said last week that the United States would not attack Iran before the election, and on Sunday he also referenced the energy cease‑fire arrangement between Russia and Ukraine.

Oil prices fell 0.75% on Tuesday to $105.87 a barrel as traders evaluated whether Russia might increase diesel supplies. Russia said its diesel exports could rise above the levels mentioned in Trump’s agreement with Moscow.
Analysts note that beyond energy factors, doubts are growing about the investment outlook driven by AI, which is also challenging the recent dollar rally.
Investors are awaiting the U.S. September Consumer Price Index (CPI) release on Wednesday, which will provide further clues on whether the Fed will tighten monetary policy further.
After two Fed officials argued that more evidence should be gathered before deciding on additional tightening, investors have abandoned bets on a rate hike later this month.

CME Group’s FedWatch tool shows traders now assign about an 80% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged at its Oct. 27‑28 meeting, up from 51% a month ago. The market also expects the Fed’s cumulative tightening by the end of 2027 to be about 75 basis points.

Standard Chartered’s global G10 FX research head and North America macro‑strategy lead Steven Englander said, “We think inflation data may come in slightly below expectations. Oil prices still pose some pre‑data‑release risk, but the factors pushing core inflation are receding. Tariffs were already a topic of last year.”
Recent oil price gains had supported the dollar and put pressure on the euro, yen and other currencies, as the euro‑zone and Japan rely far more on imported oil than the United States does.
Euro rebounds despite higher gas prices

Even though natural‑gas prices have surged again—and gas is a key driver of euro‑zone inflation—combined with lingering concerns over France’s fiscal outlook, the euro has bounced from a roughly 17‑month low.
The euro rose 0.40% against the dollar to $1.1198. On Monday it had slipped to $1.11525, the lowest since May 2025.

Englander added, “Euro‑area sovereign‑yield spreads have narrowed slightly. Regarding market views on France’s fiscal fragility, we haven’t hit the highest alert level yet, and related worries have eased.”
European natural‑gas prices climbed to their highest level since December 2022, now at €86.74 per megawatt‑hour.

Bank of Japan data showed Japan’s September wholesale‑price year‑over‑year growth at 6.8%, below the median market forecast of 7.6%. Nonetheless, the figure is enough to sustain concerns that Japanese rates could rise further. The yen appreciated 0.18% to ¥158.33 per dollar.
Investors still believe that the possibility of further BOJ tightening and potential official intervention to curb excessive exchange‑rate moves will support the yen.
The Australian dollar was at $0.69830. Earlier, the Reserve Bank of Australia released September meeting minutes showing the committee unanimously agreed to a fourth rate hike this year.

items.title: 以為搭上AI列車卻進了賭場？博通CEO點破盲點 呼應巴菲特忠告
items.title_en: Thought They Were Boarding the AI Train but Ended Up in a Casino? Broadcom CEO Highlights the Blind Spot, Echoing Buffett's Advice
paras: 巴菲特一向主張，投資人應投資自己了解的企業，而博通(AVGO-US) 執行長陳福陽認為，太多人已跨越這條界線，盲目投入市場。
巴菲特在1996年致波克夏股東的信中寫道：「投資人需要的，是正確評估特定企業的能力。你只需要能夠評估自己能力圈內的企業。這個圈子的大小並不重要，但知道它的界線至關重要。」
博通執行長陳福陽認為，太多人已跨越這條界線，盲目投入市場。
據《彭博》報導，他在新加坡表示：「許多投資人根本不知道自己在投資什麼。」他補充，這些投資人抱持「極高的期待，最後才發現自己幾乎就像置身賭場」。
巴菲特本人也並非總能精準掌握科技投資。他談到Google(GOOGL-US)時，曾感嘆這家公司不在自己的「能力圈」內，因此很晚才買進。
然而，隨著更難理解的AI技術崛起，遵循巴菲特這項原則變得更加困難。不是每個人都像班艾佛列克那樣了解AI，但也沒有人想被拋在後頭。
陳福陽與巴菲特的出發點不難理解，這也解釋了為何巴菲特提倡投資簡單的指數型基金，認為這對大多數人而言是更好的選擇。
值得說明的是，作為博通的掌舵者，陳福陽對產業前景依然看好。但他同時對長期的資本消耗感到擔憂，並直言 AI 的獲利能力最終將取決於它能否為企業帶來實質效益；然而，他認為目前許多企業的投入可能只是在「浪費錢」。
陳福陽的提醒若用另一種方式解讀，那就是：眼前這些令人驚嘆的 AI 技術固然強大，但它的「厲害」就好比法拉利跑車——之所以表現卓絕，是因為造價高昂。但在許多實際商業場景中，付出一比一的高額代價，卻未必能換來相應的實用價值。
儘管如此，一般散戶看到Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、AlphabetGOOGL-US)等企業大舉押注，很難不認為，自己只是跟隨比自己更了解這項技術及其影響的企業投資，而這些企業的信心之強，足以讓它們投入巨資。
不過，陳福陽這番話的精髓或許在於更細微的層面：投資人應該規避的是 AI 交易中「賭博式」的投機行為，而非完全拒絕 AI 概念本身。
畢竟在標普 500 指數中，有龐大權重都由 AI 概念股支撐，即便謹記「奧馬哈先知」至今依然適用的忠告，在當前的市場環境下，恐怕也早已無法完全置身事外。
paras_en: Buffett has long advocated that investors should stick to businesses they understand, and Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan believes many have crossed that line, blindly jumping into the market.

In his 1996 letter to Berkshire shareholders, Buffett wrote: "What investors need is the ability to correctly assess a particular company. You only need to be able to assess companies within your circle of competence. The size of the circle doesn’t matter, but knowing its boundaries is crucial."
Broadcom CEO Hock Tan says too many people have crossed that line and are investing blindly.

According to Bloomberg, he said in Singapore: "Many investors don’t even know what they are investing in." He added that these investors have "extremely high expectations, only to find themselves feeling like they are in a casino."
Buffett himself hasn’t always been spot‑on with tech investments. When discussing Google (GOOGL-US), he admitted the company was outside his circle of competence, so he bought it very late.
However, as ever‑more opaque AI technologies emerge, following Buffett’s rule becomes harder. Not everyone understands AI like Ben Efron, but no one wants to be left behind.
Tan’s and Buffett’s starting points are easy to grasp, which also explains why Buffett champions simple index funds as a better choice for most people.

It’s worth noting that, as Broadcom’s captain, Tan remains optimistic about industry prospects. Yet he worries about long‑term capital consumption and bluntly says AI’s profitability will ultimately depend on whether it delivers real benefits to companies; he believes many firms are currently just "wasting money" on AI.

If we read Tan’s warning another way, the dazzling AI technologies today are powerful, but their "wow factor" is like a Ferrari – exceptional performance comes at a very high cost. In many real‑world business scenarios, paying a one‑to‑one premium may not yield commensurate practical value.

Nevertheless, when retail investors see giants like Meta (META-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) pouring money into AI, it’s hard not to feel they are simply following companies that understand the technology and its impact better, and whose confidence is strong enough to justify massive spending.
Tan’s point may actually lie in a finer nuance: investors should steer clear of the "gambling‑style" speculation in AI trades, not reject the AI concept altogether.

After all, AI‑related stocks carry a huge weight in the S&P 500, and even if we keep Buffett’s "Omaha prophet" advice in mind, in today’s market it’s unlikely we can stay completely out of the picture.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉美光跌3.6%晶片股承壓 那指收低、費半連五跌
paras: 美國股市周二(13日)收低，晶片股延續近期跌勢，投資人則消化花旗集團(Citigroup)(C-US)及其他美國大型銀行喜憂參半的季度財報。
費城半導體指數下跌0.23%，連續第五個交易日走低。博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽週一將部分流入半導體產業的投資資金形容為「賭場賭博」。此外，市場傳出中國記憶體晶片廠長鑫存儲(CXMT)在技術方面取得進展，也加深市場對競爭日益激烈的憂慮。
美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)下跌3.6%，應用材料(Applied Materials)(AMAT-US)重挫近7%。博通上漲0.7%。
市場同時擔憂相關股票估值過高，週一南韓KOSPI下跌5.5%，觸及7月31日以來最低，記憶體類股承壓。
大型銀行正式拉開財報季序幕，惟花旗下跌5.6%，高盛(Goldman Sachs)(GS-US)跌0.2%，儘管兩家銀行公布的獲利均優於市場預期。
富國銀行(Wells Fargo)(WFC-US)下跌3.1%，主要因淨利息收入低於市場預期。摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)(JPM-US)下跌0.9%，該行罕見未能達到獲利預期。
蘋果(AAPL-US)盤中一度創下348.15美元歷史新高，終場上漲0.1%，收在341.27美元，市值達到4.98兆美元。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)數據，分析師平均預期，標普500指數成分股企業第三季獲利將大幅成長逾30%，主要動能來自與人工智慧(AI)相關科技公司。
市場對財報季表現強勁的預期，抵銷了部分來自美國與伊朗戰爭、債券殖利率飆升，以及高油價推升通膨的憂慮。
標普500指數在AI相關科技股帶動下，2026年以來已上漲14%。然而，該指數成分股的中位數漲幅不到5%，且超過200家成分企業今年股價下跌。
在市場預期AI領域大型企業將繳出亮眼財報背景下，標普500指數目前預估本益比不到19倍，為2023年以來最低。
費城半導體指數過去五個交易日累計下跌逾8%，但今年以來仍上漲超過70%。
標普500醫療保健指數週二下跌1.3%。嬌生(Johnson & Johnson)(JNJ-US)儘管獲利優於市場預期，股價仍重挫5.7%。
美股周二(13日)主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG + 科技五天王多收紅。Meta (META-US) 上漲2.63%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 0.088%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.30%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.43%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.37%。
費半成分股漲跌互見。輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 0.97%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 0.73%；美光 (MU-US) 下挫 3.62%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.39%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 重挫6.69%；德儀 (TXN-US) 上漲 2.17%；AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.90%。
台股 ADR 互有漲跌。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 0.17%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 0.15%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 0.71%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.24%。
企業新聞
蘋果發表首款智慧顯示器HomeView，結合7吋觸控螢幕、人臉辨識與升級版Siri AI，可辨識最多六名家庭成員，提供個人化資訊與居家控制功能，美國售價299美元。蘋果也同步推出新版Apple TV 4K、HomePod mini 2及合作開發的智慧家庭配件，擴大迎戰亞馬遜與Google。
輝達執行長黃仁勳表示，公司計劃未來一週宣布20億美元的歐洲投資案，延續過去一年已對當地投入80億美元的布局。他也在巴黎宣布對Doctolib、Genesis AI、Pigment及Entalpic等法國新創提供新資金，敦促歐洲必須加入AI競賽。

華爾街分析
資產管理公司Longbow Asset Management執行長Jake Dollarhide表示，「許多投資人感到鬆了一口氣，因為市場可能開始更關注企業財報，而不是債券市場、持續高檔的油價，以及居高不下的利率。」
Walser Wealth Management投資長 Rebecca Walser表示，「這些銀行公布的數據其實依然強勁，只是市場原本的預期太高。在目前這個財報季，過高的預期對各產業的企業而言，都是一種風險。」
